title: UPCI (Unified Crypto payment Interface)
tagline: Experience UPI on Chain with power of Crypto
description:
Currently , The payment experience is very long and complex and the end users with no technical knowledge , is not able to use crypto for payments . There are lot of transactions, Signatures , Gas fees and other things , users need to go through. So we took upon the challenge to simplify this payment experience and here enters UPI , payment infra from India , Simple and Easy to use method to send and receive payments .

We created a platform that allows users to pay on Chain with same experience as UPI , no tx , no Gas fees , no Signs , and no metamask , so if you are newbie or an expert , we have it for you . Just use your CPIN to pay on chain , with gasless transactions on Polygon Chain .

We are using Account abstraction in backend with Smart Contract , to manage the funds of the user
